sql: SELECT W FROM Goalies WHERE playerID = 'vanbijo01' AND year = 1990
SELECT T1.w FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.year = 1933 AND T2.award = 'Second Team All-Star'

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2002 AND T2.GA > 150 ORDER BY T1.birthYear DESC, CAST(T1.birthMon AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(T1.birthDay AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.name FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2010 GROUP BY T2.tmID HAVING SUM(T1.PostENG) = (SELECT MAX(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(G.PostENG) AS s FROM Goalies AS G WHERE G.year = 2010 GROUP BY G.tmID))
SELECT GP FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'broadpu01' AND year = 1922
SELECT BenchMinor, name FROM Teams ORDER BY T DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND firstNHL = '2011'

SELECT T1.award, T2.nameGiven, T2.lastName FROM AwardsPlayers AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.pos = (SELECT pos FROM AwardsPlayers WHERE pos IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pos ORDER BY COUNT(award) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T1.year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T2.oppID) OVER (), T1.name, T3.name FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamVsTeam AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T2.oppID AND T3.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 1915 AND T1.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 1915 ORDER BY W DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T1.rank, T1.year, T1.name FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.SHA >= 7 ORDER BY T2.A DESC LIMIT 1
